# Abstract {.unnumbered}

[Official McGill Guidelines](https://www.mcgill.ca/gps/thesis/thesis-guidelines/preparation):
If the language of the thesis is neither English nor French (only allowed
for specific language Units) then a third abstract in the language of the
thesis is required.

Abstracts in English and French are mandatory and must be text only, i.e.
no images, special characters (apart from the West European character set
excluding the "OE" and "oe"), chemical or mathematical formulae, or special
formatting (e.g. lists, tables). Abstracts have a maximum limit of 4,000
characters.
